capacityNote: Capacities compared with the original design.
technicalShortcut: Press D to show or hide technical details
usageNote: Suspend time is excluded. Reconnecting power ends this session.
usagePartial: Recorded from the first available reading; suspend time is excluded.
usageEmpty: Unplug the charger to start recording battery usage.
usageNoPercentage: The battery driver has not reported a percentage yet.
usageError: Could not update battery usage. Retrying automatically.
usageStorageError: Could not save usage history. Check access to your local state directory.
